name: Frisco Family Services Market
hoursNotes: Apply first at the main office (8780 Third Street, Frisco) and meet with a case manager before shopping at the Market.
requirements: Must live in Frisco or within Frisco ISD boundaries. Application requires proof of income, proof of residency, and government ID for household members.
notes: Frisco's only community food pantry; grocery-store-style choice shopping, curbside pickup, and home delivery for seniors.
